_metadata.note: These values are model defaults where the PDF does not provide station throat capacity, route-locking rules, exact block capacity, or task-level station occupation data. They are not official infrastructure capacity data.
pdf_replacements: min_depart_headway_s is derived at load time from headway_constraints.csv when the PDF Shuohuang 2 万吨 headway exceeds this default.
station-specific track_capacity is read from station_resources.csv, whose source is the PDF station table track count including mainline tracks.
technical operation occupation is read from technical_operation_times.csv and applied only through station_operation_assignments.csv.
heavy-empty-heavy flow continuity is enforced, but initial flow stock is a scenario assumption because the PDF bundle does not provide initial rolling-stock inventory.
needs_replacement_with: section capacity/headway rules by train type and direction
